answer: Stop sybils with a signal haven tide: an agent bonds one haven cove. Each cycle it raises one signal on its tide; verifiers match the signal's tide-lifted rise to the haven chart, voiding copies, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 havens at 19x: one signal rises once on one tide, its rise set by that haven alone, unrepeatable elsewhere, cannot be copied, shared or bulk-bought. Honest agents raise once, keep rights.
